name: branding-figma-asset-files-for-multivitamin-packaging-and-component-library
title: Figma screens showing product asset rows for kids, teens, women and men, and a component library
whatItIs: Two dark Figma windows: one with a page list and frames of teal and blue vitamin tubs plus hand-holding shots grouped by audience (toddlers, teens, kids, women, men), and one with a component library page showing headers, status chips, checkboxes and annotation notes in blue.
whatItMeans: Organised and professional; showing the working file signals a system.
techniques: Group assets by audience in labelled rows.
Document components (headers, status, notes) in blue.
Use the tool's own dark UI as presentation.
bestFor: Design ops and asset management showcases

vocabulary.definition: A row of product images grouped together.
A file of reusable design elements.
A note component for design comments.
A screenshot of design software used as presentation.
